about.title: Waa Ayo Minna
about.subtitle: Farshaxan-yaqaan Finnish ah iyo Macallin Visual Arts
about.intro: Waxaan ahay Minna Kattelus, farshaxan-yaqaan Finnish ah oo shaqadeedu ku saleysan tahay sahaminta iftiinka Nordic iyo dareenka dadka iyada oo loo marayo sawir casri ah.

journey.title: Socdaalkayga Farshaxannimo
journey.p1: Waxaan ku dhashay oo ku koray Finland, xiriirkaygu dabeecadda iyo landscape-ka Finnish wuxuu ahaa mid aan looga maarmaan karin ilaa aan yaraa. Caruurnimadiidii, waxaan saacado ku qaadan jiray eegista sida iftiinka uu u beddelayo kaymaha iyo hararka. Xiisaha hore ee iftiinka iyo midabka ayaa noqday foundation-ka shaqadayda farshaxannimo.
journey.p2: Ka dib markaan dhamaystay waxbarashadayda Vaasa Academy of Fine Arts, waxaan soo gashay sahaminta techniques iyo media kala duwan. Waxay ahayd Master's in Fine Arts ee University of Helsinki markaan helay codkayga gaarka ah: isku dhafka Nordic landscape, emotional abstraction iyo palette midab oo ay dhiirigeliyeen xilliyadda Finnish.
journey.p3: Shaqadaygu farshaxannimo wuxuu isku daraa techniques dhaqameed oo casri ah, oo ugu horeeya ka shaqeeya acrylic iyo oil on canvas. Waxaan aad u rumaysanahay awoodda isbeddelka farshaxanka iyo awooddeeda ay ku xirto waxa nagu hareeraysan iyo dareennadayada ugu qoto dheer.

teaching.title: Teaching iyo Vocational Work
teaching.p1: Marka laga reebo shaqadayda farshaxannimo, waxaan ahay macallin xarun vocational ah halkaas oo aan la wadaago mabda'a sawirka dareenka creative landscape. Teaching-ku way i hodmisay sida artist ahaan markaan awood u yeesho inaan isbeddelo oo aan la wadaago farshaxanka ardaydayda, dhiirigelinta creativity iyo personal expression.
teaching.p2: Waxaan aad u rumaysanahay awoodda isbeddelka farshaxanka iyo awooddeeda ay ku xirto dadka iyo dareennadooda ugu qoto dheer. Classes-kayga, waxaan ku dhiirigeliyaa ardayda inay helaan codkooda farshaxannimo oo ay ku tijaabiyaan iyaga oo aan ka baqeyn khaladaadka.
teaching.p3: Teaching waxay ii oggolaataa inaan soo celiyo wixii farshaxanku ii siiyay: hab lagu arko adduunka dareen ka badan iyo qalab lagu muujiyo waxa aan la muujin karin.

philosophy.title: Falsafadayda Farshaxannimo
philosophy.quote: Farshaxanku ma aha waxaad aragto kaliya, laakiin waxaad dareentid. Brush stroke kasta waa dareen, midab kasta waa xusuus, iyo shaqo kasta waa window ku jira ruuxa Nordic landscape.
philosophy.text: Shaqadaydu waxay raadinaysaa inay qabato essence-ka Finnish landscapes iyo dareenka ay keenaan. Kuma raadinayo inaan abuuro literal representations, laakiin emotional interpretations oo u yeedhaya daawadaha contemplation-kooda. Iftiinka, atmosphere-ka iyo midabku waa qalabkayga si aan u dhiso buundo u dhexeeya adduunka dibadda iyo adduunkayaga gudaha.

cta.title: Ma xiiseynaysaa shaqadayda?
cta.text: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan kula xiriiro. Hadday tahay inaad gato shaqo, commission gaara ah, ama si fudud sheeko ku saabsan farshaxanka.

q1.question: Ma qabtaa commissions custom ah?
q1.answer: Haa, waxaan aqbalaa commissions gaara ah. Igala soo xiriir fikradahaaga waxaanan bixin doonaa qiimo iyo timeline.

q2.question: Ma dirtaa internationally?
q2.answer: Hadda waxaan u dirnaa Yurub oo dhan. Shipping dibadda Yurub, igala soo xiriir si aan ugaga wada hadalno options iyo costs.

q3.question: Shaqooyinku ma ku jiraan certificate?
q3.answer: Dhammaan shaqooyinkayga original ah waxaa ku jira certificate saxiixan oo numbered ah oo xaqiijinaya authenticity-gooda.

q4.question: Ma bixisaa prints?
q4.answer: Hadda waxaan kaliya iibinayaa shaqooyin original ah. Haddii aad xiiseyneyso limited edition prints, igala soo xiriir macluumaad dheeraad ah.
